items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: When Celestin played the ballroom, they asked me to bring my horn and come and sit in, so I did.

ctx.x:
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

busted up. We had to take the bus back to Minneapolis and we were all stranded there, some went home. I didn't go home and I stayed right in Monroe and I joined a local band by the name of Ben Burton. We played jobs around until a band from New Orleans came to play a dance in Monroe, and the gentleman's name was Oscar "Papa" Celestin.
